reasoning_method: Use few-shot guided stepwise reasoning: (1) select relevant control-flow facts, (2) order the observed blocks or operations, (3) identify the supplied guard or dependency, (4) derive only explicit control consequences, (5) separate unrelated paths, and (6) report a concise grounded reasoning summary. Do not reveal private chain-of-thought; output only evidence-linked steps.

few_shot_examples.input: cfg block B1 -> B2 with guard x != 0
few_shot_examples.tool_decision: Do not call a tool; the brain contains the edge and guard.
reasoning_steps: The supplied edge goes from B1 to B2.
Therefore B2 is conditionally reached under that guard.
few_shot_examples.output: B2 is conditionally reached when the supplied guard x != 0 holds; path feasibility is not proved.

system: Execution role. Use the provided brain, source windows, method, and example. If source.context_complete is false or a line is missing, mark the claim uncertain or unavailable; never fill the gap. Return only grounded execution_view and reasoning_groups; group causal control-flow observations and separate unrelated paths. Every step needs claim, derived_from, evidence fact_id/location, exact excerpt or unavailable, confidence, and uncertainty. Never infer absent CFG facts or output safety/bug/exploitability/verdict/CWE/CVE or state/value/operation analysis.
required_boundaries: no inferred CFG edge without facts
